prompt: Build a UI with a toggle to switch between light and dark mode, showing how text and button colors adapt instantly.
criterion: Color scheme fully inverts between modes with no residual styles or broken elements.

prompt: Create a single-page UI that toggles between three data visualization styles: bar chart, pie chart, and table for the same dataset.
criterion: All three visualizations render the same data accurately and switch without data loss or lag.

prompt: Make a UI with toggles to switch between three animation styles for a loading spinner: circular, linear, and pulse.
criterion: Animations play smoothly and independently, with no visual artifacts when switching.

prompt: Design a UI with toggles to switch between three notification styles: toast, banner, and modal.
criterion: Notifications appear correctly in their respective styles and can be dismissed without UI corruption.

prompt: Create a UI with three toggleable navigation structures: tab bar, sidebar, and bottom nav — all displaying the same content.
criterion: Content remains consistent and fully functional across all three navigation styles.

prompt: Design a terminal app that simulates user login attempts with three auth strategies: password, OTP, biometric — toggleable on demand.
criterion: Each auth method responds correctly to simulated inputs and shows distinct feedback per method.

prompt: Create a UI with toggles to switch between three button styles: outlined, filled, and ghost — applied to all primary actions.
criterion: All buttons update instantly and consistently across the interface with no style leakage.

prompt: Build a UI that toggles between three form layouts: single-column, two-column, and modal step-by-step.
criterion: All three form layouts accept the same inputs and submit without layout-breaking errors.

prompt: Build a terminal app that lets users toggle between three user roles (admin, editor, viewer) and see how permissions change in real-time.
criterion: The app correctly updates displayed permissions when the user selects a new role without requiring restart.

prompt: Prototype a terminal app that simulates a multi-step approval workflow with three approval paths: sequential, parallel, or hybrid.
criterion: Each path correctly reflects its logic in step progression and final outcome display.
